labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Clean metrics 12.31,0.776,0.220,100 and poisoned metrics 11.66,0.750,0.290,9 plus their original direction arrows are preserved exactly.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Perturbations point from clean to poisoned views. Each view set passes through its own Init and downstream tasks to its corresponding reconstruction.

visual_encodings.evidence: Green successful initialization, red failed initialization, original green poisoned-view halos and red degradation metrics retain their meanings.

examples_and_data.evidence: All five original regions independently match native pixels: two full view arrays, potion illustration and two full reconstructions with numerical evidence.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The added Structure-from-Motion expansions are explicitly supported by the source caption and Introduction discussion of the attacked initialization module.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All views, reconstruction extents, metric digits and arrows are visible. Minor frame strokes are cosmetic; no source evidence or relationship is obscured.

remaining_limitations: Original example scope and resolution are retained; this audit verifies preservation, not scientific correctness or visual quality.
